caption: The drawing depicts three vertical ribbons each featuring a cross emblem at the center. The ribbon on the left is black with a white geometric cross design and has short, loose fringes at both the top and bottom edges. The central ribbon is light purple with a similar geometric cross pattern in black and has V-shaped notches at both the top and bottom ends. The ribbon on the right is bright red, with the same geometric cross motif in black, and V-shaped notches at the top and bottom. All three ribbons are aligned vertically and positioned next to each other against a plain, off-white background. The ribbons are rendered with a texture that suggests fabric, and the cross designs are composed of small, repeating geometric shapes.
title: Book Marks
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
